as_told.title: Three flying saucers hover over a church at a Port Arthur school
as_told.place_text: Port Arthur, Texas, USA (DQ Queen Elementary)

plain: Mario Woods, an Air Force veteran who later guarded nuclear weapons, says that in 1961, when he was about six, his mother pointed at the sky near De Queen Elementary School in Port Arthur, Texas, and said, "Look at those flying saucers." He says there were three of them, beautiful, hovering just 25 to 50 feet over a church. In a later telling he names his mother and his sister as fellow witnesses, and he tells it as the start of a lifetime of strange encounters.
